newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: New term for "Red Vienna' mayor, but in coalition.
newsitem.headline: New term for "Red Vienna' mayor, but in coalition.

text.p: Vienna city council on Friday re-elected Social Democrat mayor Michael Haeupl for a second term, but for the first time in its history the capital known as "Red Vienna" will be run in coalition with conservatives.

The ruling Social Democrats lost their absolute majority in regional elections on October 13 when their support slumped to a post-World War Two low of 39.1 percent and they were forced to seek a coalition with the conservative People's Party.

The result wiped out the Social Democrats' grip on the richest and most powerful region of Austria, traditionally a showcase for the party's policies, with its huge public housing projects and massive health budget.
Haeupl has been mayor of Vienna since November 1994 and is widely seen as the second most powerful figure in the party after Chancellor Franz Vranitzky.
